dataset.exact_duplicate_policy: preserve official test before de-duplication, then split validation from leakage-clean train

task.selection_train_sampling: deterministic label-stratified sample from clean train; validation and test remain complete

candidate_family.window_operation: standardize each hidden output on the fit split, then mean adjacent standardized outputs

baseline: word 1-2 plus character 2-5 TF-IDF with the identical averaged SGD logistic head on identical fit rows

uncertainty.limitation: BANKING77 releases no user or source-group identifiers, so paired uncertainty is row-level

research_scope: Internal research benchmark. Any later public release is a separate project-owner decision.
